title: The Exact Playbook to Go from $0 to Your First $100,000
channel: I Will Teach You To Be Rich
summary: Slow-wealth playbook: pay off high-interest debt, automate savings, hold low-cost index funds, and avoid social-media get-rich-quick traps and side-hustle hustle culture.

assertions.quote: The first 100K is the hardest part. It gets a lot easier after that.

verdicts.note: Compounding makes later increments larger, though the specific threshold is arbitrary.

assertions.quote: the way you feel about money is often uncorrelated with how much you're actually making

verdicts.note: Lifestyle inflation is well documented; surveys show many high earners living paycheck to paycheck.

assertions.quote: 27% credit card interest will wipe out those gains and they can destroy your wealth faster than any plan can fix

verdicts.note: Paying down a debt at twenty-plus percent is a guaranteed return no diversified investment reliably matches.

assertions.quote: I personally invest the vast majority of my net worth in index funds and or target date funds
the difference between paying a 0.2% management fee and 1% management fee is nearly $400,000

verdicts.note: Fee drag compounds; standard calculators show one percent costing roughly a quarter of terminal wealth over thirty-plus years.

assertions.quote: These are meme stocks. These are people buying Airbnb's without properly accounting for costs
Real wealth is almost always built through smart systems that take time.
over 80% of managers lose to index funds

verdicts.note: SPIVA scorecards consistently show most active funds trailing their benchmarks over ten-plus years.
